local out={}
local function snapshot(t)
  local a,b={},{}
  local k=next(t)
  while k do a[#a+1]=tostring(k).."="..tostring(t[k]); k=next(t,k) end
  for k,v in pairs(t) do b[#b+1]=tostring(k).."="..tostring(v) end
  out[#out+1]=table.concat(a,"|")
  out[#out+1]=table.concat(b,"|")
  out[#out+1]=tostring(#t)
end
local t={}
